title: Mold Remediation Asbestos Laboratory Turnaround Tariff
content:
The laboratory turnaround for pre-removal asbestos samples on a Mold Remediation job follows the lead time, which is the scheduled start date less the opened date in calendar days.

| Lead time (calendar days) | Turnaround | Charge added to the sampling line |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or fewer (at most the rush lead days) | 24-hour | 40 percent (the rush percentage) of the tier's asbestos sampling fee, but never less than the rush minimum fee of 200.00 |
| 3 to 5 (above the rush lead days of 2 and at most the expedite lead days of 5) | 72-hour | The flat expedite fee of 95.00 |
| 6 or more | Standard | None |

**Tariff note.** A lead time of at most the rush lead days buys the 24-hour turnaround, charged at the rush percentage of the tier's asbestos sampling fee but never less than the rush minimum fee; a lead time above the rush lead days and at most the expedite lead days buys the 72-hour turnaround at the expedite fee; any longer lead time uses the standard turnaround with no turnaround charge.

**The 24-hour charge** is the larger of two figures: 40 percent of the tier's asbestos sampling fee, and 200.00.

Hypothetical figures:

- Lead time 2 days, tier asbestos sampling fee 610.00: 40 percent is 244.00, above 200.00, so the charge is 244.00.
- Lead time 0 days (work scheduled to start on the opened date), tier fee 380.00: 40 percent is 152.00, below 200.00, so the charge is 200.00.
- Lead time 3 days: 95.00. Lead time 5 days: 95.00. Lead time 6 days: no charge.
